hero.label: DocPats · Medical editorial team
hero.headline: About us
hero.deck: An independent medical editorial team led by a practising physician. All materials are based exclusively on peer-reviewed scientific sources.

editor.name: Dr. Ismail Ismailov
editor.title: Editor-in-chief of DocPats · Otolaryngologist
editor.bio: Practising otolaryngologist and founder of the DocPats medical platform. Under his editorial leadership, all analytical materials on the platform are reviewed for compliance with current clinical data and evidence-based medicine standards.

mission.p1: DocPats was created to give doctors and patients access to in-depth analysis of current medical and scientific data. We do not replace medical journals — we make their content accessible and applicable in practice.
mission.p2: Every DocPats analytical piece synthesises data from multiple peer-reviewed sources, giving the reader a comprehensive picture of current issues in medicine and the biological sciences.

items.title: Peer-reviewed sources only
items.text: All materials are based on publications in peer-reviewed scientific journals. We do not use unverified sources, social media, or non-professional publications.

items.title: Up-to-date data
items.text: Priority is given to publications from the last 2-3 years. The publication date of each source is indicated for every topic.

items.title: Editorial review
items.text: All materials are reviewed by the editor-in-chief for compliance with clinical practice and current treatment standards.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Every article ends with a list of all sources used, including direct links to the original publications.

items.title: Independence
items.text: DocPats does not accept funding from pharmaceutical companies and does not publish promotional content disguised as editorial material.

disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer
disclaimer.text: All DocPats materials are for informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations. For medical care, please consult a qualified specialist. Do not ignore professional medical advice or delay seeking care based on information read on this site.
